lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular 2D lattice with approximately 5-6 horizontal rows visible in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a high-contrast grid where spots act as nodes at the intersections across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity highlights on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, high-intensity yellow pixel clusters (commensal fish) are visible near the pectoral fin and the anterior gill region.
